question: A ferromagnetic core of mass $m = 200$ g is placed inside a solenoid. The material undergoes a cyclic magnetization process with a frequency of $f = 50$ Hz. The area of the hysteresis loop (B-H curve) is given as $A_{loop} = 2000$ J/m$^3$. The density of the material is $\rho = 8000$ kg/m$^3$. The specific heat capacity of the material is $s = 400$ J/kg-K. Assuming the solenoid is thermally insulated, how long will it take for the temperature of the core to rise by $\Delta T = 10^\circ$C?
